grain: One row per employer reporting unit for the 2024-25 WGEA Gender Equality Reporting, identified by Employer name plus Employer ABN; each row also carries a contextual 2023-24 comparison block of four GPG columns, so a row is an employer-year-pair record rather than a single-year measure.

groups.name: employer_identity_and_classification
groups.purpose: Identifies the reporting employer and its reporting context: name, ABN reporting identifier, sector, employer size band and industry classification. These are the row's identity and scope qualifiers, not measures.

groups.name: workforce_representation_by_quartile
groups.purpose: Current-year (2024-25) female representation measures: total workforce % women and % women in each of the four pay quartiles. Stored as decimal fractions, not whole percentages.

groups.name: remuneration_by_quartile
groups.purpose: Current-year (2024-25) average total remuneration in dollars for the total workforce and for each pay quartile. These are pay levels, not revenue or business income.

groups.name: current_year_gender_pay_gaps
groups.purpose: 2024-25 gender pay gap measures (average and median, base salary and total remuneration) for the reporting employer. Stored as decimal fractions; negative values indicate a gap favouring women.

groups.name: prior_year_gender_pay_gaps_comparison
groups.purpose: Contextual 2023-24 comparison block of the same four gender pay gap measures, kept separate from the current-year block. Blank means no prior-year comparison, not a zero gap.

entity_types.name: employer_reporting_unit
entity_types.definition: An employer reporting unit that submits WGEA Gender Equality Reporting results for a reporting year, identified by its reporting ABN; its legal form and company-wide scope are not established by this source.

employer.rationale: The row's subject is the reporting employer; Employer ABN is the reporting identifier and Employer name is a non-unique label, so both are needed to bind identity. No legal form or group-wide scope is inferred.

cautions: Employer name is not a unique key; identity should bind on Employer ABN, which is a reporting identifier and not proof of legal form or company-wide scope.
The sheet name '2. Employers ' has a trailing space and must be preserved exactly.
Rows 1-3 are title/context rows; the real header is row 4 (skip_rows=3).

The header spans two year groups: columns F-I are 2024-25 and columns J-M are 2023-24 (headers carry a trailing space). The 2023-24 columns are contextual comparison values and must not be merged with the 2024-25 measures.
Duplicate-looking header labels appear twice; disambiguate by year group, not by position alone.
GPG and % women values are stored as decimal fractions (e.g. 0.244 = 24.4%), not whole percentages.
Blank cells in the 2023-24 block mean no prior-year comparison, not a zero gap.
Employer size range is a band, not an exact headcount; remuneration figures are pay, not revenue or business income.
This sheet is employer-level results; the '3. Corporate groups ' and '4. Corporate group info' sheets are separate grains and must not be joined as if employer rows were group rows.
The 'How to use the GPG Spreadsheet' sheet is documentation and must not be used as a data reader.
This workbook does not contain all dashboard policy/board indicators; absence here is not evidence of absence.
